notes: The 1992 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: contracts, namings, dedications and design approvals.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. findings.address_as_written: Larsen Park - approval of removal of plane
findings.description: After testing found dangerously high lead levels in the jet plane that served as a play structure at Larsen Park, with repair put at $40,000 to $50,000 and soil cleanup at up to $100,000 more, the Recreation and Park Commission approved removing the plane; a museum had offered to take it at no cost.
